persons.name: Bhāravi
persons.evidence: bhāravir-ity-avekṣya mānuṣyakaṃ ... mātā-pitṛ-svakṛta-puṇya-vivarddhan-ārtham-etāṃ bhiṣag - ṣa - - - cakāra kī[rttim]

purpose: construction of a water conduit (kīrti) and land grant for the merit of the donor and his parents (mātāpitṛsvakṛtapuṇyavivarddhanārtham)
notes: The inscription records the foundation of a water conduit and an endowment of land south-west of Yūpagrāma (in modern Patan) by Bhāravi, who appears to have held the title or profession of physician (bhiṣaj).
